wellbeingPlus.doneBody: Thanks. It is compared with your usual range, never a single day.

sustained.mood: Your mood has been below your usual range for several days.
sustained.fatigue: Your fatigue has been above your usual range for several days.
sustained.stress: Your stress has been above your usual range for several days.
sustained.crewConflict: Friction with the crew has been above usual for several days.

wellbeingPlus.sustainedNote: Not a diagnosis. Behavioral health will see this alert confidentially; your crew will not.
wellbeingPlus.limits: Limits: the app does not handle severe crises (in immediate danger, tell the medical officer and use the mission emergency channel). The reaction test is inspired by the PVT-B; it is not NASA's validated software.

fit.title: Critical-task fitness
fit.requiredBody: Before a critical task you need a “fit” result today.

pvt.disclaimer: Inspired by the PVT-B (Basner et al., 2011): stimuli every 1–4 s, lapse ≥ 355 ms. Compared with your baseline on this same tablet. Not the validated software.
pvt.onlyFitToEarth: Mission control only receives “fit: yes / not confirmed”, never your times.

screening.title: Biweekly questionnaire
screening.subtitle: PHQ-2 + GAD-2 · before your psychological conference
screening.prompt: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?
screening.private: Confidential: only behavioral health will see it. Mission control will only know you completed it.

items.phq1: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
items.gad1: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
items.gad2: Not being able to stop or control worrying

screening.positiveBody: Your answers suggest it might help to talk to someone. Behavioral health will receive a confidential alert; your crew will not see it.
screening.negativeBody: Saved confidentially for your next conference.
screening.source: PHQ-2 and GAD-2 (Pfizer, free to use). PHQ-9 is not used because it requires a crisis protocol.

talk.title: I want to talk to someone
talk.subtitle: Behavioral health on Earth · confidential
talk.cardBody: Message or session, with the real link delay
talk.cta: I want to talk to someone
talk.invisible: Invisible to the crew: it creates no onboard alerts and does not appear in shared alerts.
talk.delay: Minimum round trip with the current link: {{rtt}} (plus signal outages).
talk.placeholder: Type or dictate whatever you want to share…
talk.sessionDefault: I'm requesting a private session with behavioral health.
talk.replyMessage: We received your message. Thanks for writing. We'll reply personally in the next communication window.
talk.replySession: We received your request. We propose a private session in the next available link window.
talk.crisis: If you feel you are in immediate danger, tell the onboard medical officer and use the mission emergency channel: this chat is delayed.

privacy.title: Wellbeing privacy
privacy.subtitle: Who sees what
privacy.sharedOff: Not shared with the crew (recommended default)
privacy.sharedOn: Sharing your status with commander and medical officer
privacy.shareTitle: Share with commander and medical officer
privacy.shareBody: Off by default. If enabled, they see your summary status and fitness, never the detail.
privacy.emergencyOn: An emergency triage is active: commander and medical officer temporarily see your status.
privacy.whoSees: What each role sees of YOUR data
privacy.footer: Computed with the same rule the server applies (domain/access/visibility.ts). You always see everything of yours.
